exposure: history of vaginal delivery before CS
cohort: 417 women with a history of cesarean section laboring in public health facilities in southern Ethiopia
finding: The incidence of vaginal births after cesarean was 51.1% (CI, 46%-56%), and successful VBAC was associated with a history of vaginal delivery before CS, favorable Bishop score at admission, greater than 4 cm cervical dilatation at admission, and clear amniotic fluid.
